population.label: Population (ACS)
population.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
population.note: Total residents from the ACS (B01003). County totals are set to match the Census Bureau's population estimates, so they carry no margin of error.

median_age.label: Median age
median_age.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
median_age.note: Half of residents are older and half are younger (B01002).

bachelors_or_higher.label: Adults with a bachelor's degree or more
bachelors_or_higher.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
bachelors_or_higher.note: Share of adults age 25 and older whose highest degree is a bachelor's or higher (B15003). Margins of error are at 90% confidence; for this share they use the Census Bureau's approximation for proportions.

hs_or_higher.label: Adults with a high school diploma or more
hs_or_higher.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
hs_or_higher.note: Share of adults age 25 and older with a high school diploma, GED or higher (B15003). Margins of error are at 90% confidence; for this share they use the Census Bureau's approximation for proportions.

rent_burden.label: Renters paying 30% or more of income on rent
rent_burden.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
rent_burden.note: Renter households whose gross rent is 30% or more of household income (B25070). Households where the share could not be computed (no income or no cash rent) are left out. Margins of error are at 90% confidence; for this share they use the Census Bureau's approximation for proportions.

owner_cost_burden.label: Owners with a mortgage paying 30% or more on housing
owner_cost_burden.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
owner_cost_burden.note: Owner households with a mortgage whose monthly owner costs are 30% or more of household income (B25091). Not-computed households are left out. Margins of error are at 90% confidence; for this share they use the Census Bureau's approximation for proportions.

medicaid_share.label: People with Medicaid or other means-tested coverage
medicaid_share.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
medicaid_share.note: Share of the civilian population not in institutions with Medicaid or other means-tested public coverage, alone or with other insurance (C27007). The survey tends to undercount Medicaid enrollment. Margins of error are at 90% confidence; for this share they use the Census Bureau's approximation for proportions.

uninsured_acs.label: People without health insurance (ACS)
uninsured_acs.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
uninsured_acs.note: Share of the civilian population not in institutions with no health insurance at the time of the survey (B27010). The 2010-2014 period mostly predates Ohio's 2014 Medicaid expansion. Margins of error are at 90% confidence; for this share they use the Census Bureau's approximation for proportions.

disability_share.label: People with a disability
disability_share.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates
disability_share.note: Share of the civilian population not in institutions reporting a hearing, vision, thinking, walking, self-care or independent-living difficulty (B18101). Margins of error are at 90% confidence; for this share they use the Census Bureau's approximation for proportions.
